testcase.name: factory result verification accepts its original attached child
revocation releases attached partial child before constructor returns
manifest admission is atomic when insufficient slots remain
failed release retains finite obligation and never becomes success
lost manifest worker denies the whole factory before any child exists
capacity denies before another factory can run
lost original worker denies construction before any resource exists
duplicate retirement invokes one actual close
unattached reservation factory result remains funded for cleanup
known unattached factory result is rejected but still cleaned
manifest constructor retains unused slots until actual construction ends
normal manifest retirement releases exact children once and removes all obligations
duplicate actual manifest child retains one original close authority
reentrant rejected construction preserves the enclosing factory ownership
callback interrupt cannot kill reserved physical release worker
early native acknowledgement does not recycle still running release
late hook racing terminal recycle notifies the original ticket once
